claim_boundary: One untouched run of the frozen held-out split. Do not edit the prompt, tools, budgets, or model after reading a held-out grade. Four tasks do not support a generalization rate.

model.selection_rule: Same snapshot as mlsys-coding-agent-e2e-dev-v1. Do not switch models after a development task has been generated.

budgets.wall_seconds_reason: Same generation-speed basis as mlsys-coding-agent-e2e-dev-v1. Set before any held-out task is graded.

success: reward.decide success is true, the diff is non-empty, and the transcript contains an applied replace_text, write_file, or apply_patch.
